headline: Africa $211B Corporate Debt Market Leaves Businesses Short of Long-Term Capital
summary: Africa's $211 billion corporate debt market relies heavily on syndicated loans, which account for 81 percent of outstanding corporate debt, while only seven companies raised $1 billion through IPOs in 2025.
why: Limited access to equity markets and long-term capital constrains corporate growth and infrastructure funding across African economies.

impacts.name: African corporate debt market
impacts.why: Heavy reliance on syndicated loans rather than equity or bond markets restricts long-term corporate financing.
